# Bohinj Ski Week

## What this is
Bohinj Ski Week is a 5-day learn-to-ski package run by Apartmaji Žnidar (Daša Žnidar s.p.) in Bohinj, Slovenia. Guests arrive Sunday and ski Monday through Friday, staying in self-catering apartments in Bohinjska Bistrica. Groups are split by age (adults and children learn separately) and by skiing level.

## Who it is for
Beginners and improving skiers, including families with children, who want a full ski holiday (accommodation, lessons, ski passes) without the cost of major Alpine resorts such as Austria or France. Quality and infrastructure are comparable at roughly 30-40% lower cost.

## Program by day
- Sunday: 3:00 PM arrival and check-in. 5:00-8:00 PM: collect ski equipment, arrange ski passes, briefing.
- Monday: Skiing at Kozji hrbet, 9:00 AM-1:00 PM. Free afternoon.
- Tuesday: Skiing at Kozji hrbet, 9:00 AM-1:00 PM. Free afternoon.
- Wednesday: Skiing at Soriška Planina, 9:00 AM-1:00 PM. Free afternoon (Bled recommended).
- Thursday: Skiing at Vogel, 9:00 AM-1:00 PM. Evening ski party.
- Friday: Check-out in the morning. Skiing at Soriška Planina, 10:00 AM-2:00 PM. Departure.

Resort assignment can vary depending on snow, weather, and group skiing level.

Instructors teach in English, German, Croatian and Serbian. Groups are split by age and skiing level, and the instructor matches the language to the group.

## Prices (per package, in EUR)
- 1 person: EUR 1,650
- 2 people: EUR 1,950
- 3 people: EUR 2,390
- 4 people: EUR 2,650
- 5 people: EUR 3,320
- 6 people: EUR 3,980

## What is included
Apartment accommodation, group ski lessons with an instructor, and ski passes for the program days.

## What is not included
Ski equipment rental: +EUR 80 per adult, +EUR 65 per child, for the week. Food and travel to Bohinj are also not included.

## Discounts and options
Children up to 14 years old receive a EUR 100 discount on the package price. Ski school is optional per person: guests who already ski can skip lessons and the quote is adjusted; non-skiers can use the wellness facilities and swimming pool instead. Early-bird: book with a deposit by September 30, 2026 and ski equipment rental is free for the whole group (skis, boots and helmets), worth up to EUR 290 for a family of four. The package price itself does not change.

## Example
A family of 2 adults and 2 children under 14 pays EUR 2,450 after the children's discount (package EUR 2,650 minus EUR 100 per child). Equipment rental adds EUR 290 for this family, so EUR 2,740 in total. With the early-bird offer the rental is free and the total stays EUR 2,450. The package price itself is never discounted.

## Cancellation
Full refund for cancellations up to 7 days before arrival. A 30% deposit secures the booking; the balance and payment details are agreed with the guest directly.

## Ski weeks, season 2026/2027
Weeks run Sunday to Friday from December 13, 2026 to March 12, 2027:
Dec 13-18, 2026; Dec 20-25, 2026; Jan 10-15, 2027; Jan 17-22, 2027; Jan 24-29, 2027; Jan 31 - Feb 5, 2027; Feb 7-12, 2027; Feb 28 - Mar 5, 2027; Mar 7-12, 2027.

## How to book
Submit the booking form on the website with preferred week, group size, and contact details. No payment is taken on the website. The team replies within 24 hours to confirm availability. Once dates are confirmed, a 30% deposit secures the booking; the balance and payment details are agreed directly.
